analysis: Examined the following changes. (1) The new ClusterPairUpdateProgress.swift (head 1-76) adds a plain Codable status value. Its tolerant Phase decoder maps unknown phases to .checking, which is never ready, so an unknown phase does not falsely signal drained or restarting. The value carries no secrets: the version strings, timestamps and detail text are peer self-reported. (2) ClusterServiceWire.swift head 75-77 adds an optional pairUpdate field to ClusterServiceStatus. This status is exchanged over the keyed link control channel between the paired Macs. (3) ClusterOnboardingFlow.swift head 448-456 adds oneBuild(). It requires a nonempty set of pinned members, every member answered (no nil digest) and exactly one worker digest before a replan. This is fail-closed. (4) The configuration.md docs add DARKBLOOM_NO_UPDATE_CHECK coverage for the cluster pair's update slot (line 410). The cluster console text in the reviewed head 1456-1657 appears unchanged per the range map. No regression was identified against TB-002/TB-003/TB-013 or T-013/T-043. The new field is self-reported peer state, and both Macs belong to the same operator (ADV-001 already controls both). Integration questions remain because the supplied evidence does not include the code that drives the update. The ClusterPairUpdate supervisor, ClusterServiceCommand.swift supervisorConfiguration and the update install path are not visible. The next pass should verify: (a) release verification and signature checks are unchanged before staging/install (A-011/A-017, T-054); (b) a peer's pairUpdate phase only gates drain timing and cannot trigger install of an unverified artifact or bypass drain of in-flight consumer requests (A-001); (c) the detail/target strings from a peer are not logged with sensitive data or used unsanitized; (d) oneBuild compares worker digests that are locally verified, not just peer-reported, before planning.
